name: Staghelm Point
summary: Staghelm Point is an ancient night elven watchtower perched atop a craggy peak in northeastern Silithus. Overlooking the encroaching dunes and the nearby caverns of Twilight's Run, the tower stands as a vigil against the ancient threats haunting the desert.

sections.title: A Silent Watch Above the Sands
sections.body: Rising high above the arid flats of northeastern Silithus, Staghelm Point is crowned by a solitary night elf tower. The outpost serves as a lonely sentinel, keeping watch over the wasteland and the shadowed cultists lurking in nearby caves like Twilight's Run. Watched over by Ralo'shan the Eternal Watcher and accompanied by a bronze drake circling overhead, the tower bears the proud and tragic name of the Staghelm lineage—a reminder of the immense sacrifices made by the Kaldorei during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands.

faq.answer: The solitary tower is guarded by Ralo'shan the Eternal Watcher, while a majestic bronze drake from the Brood of Nozdormu keeps a perpetual patrol in the skies above.
Down the path winding away from the peak lies Twilight's Run, a cavern and surrounding camp crawling with fanatical members of the Twilight's Hammer cult.

angles.text: Staghelm Point evokes the solemn history of the War of the Shifting Sands, standing as a stark reminder of the Kaldorei's heavy sacrifices in holding back the horrors beneath Silithus.
The tower bears the Staghelm name, offering a contemplative vantage over the corrupted, arid wilderness that defies the balance of nature.
